character.name: A friendly pixel-art office worker
character.prompt: A friendly pixel-art office worker for a cozy top-down 2D virtual-office game, low top-down view (bird's-eye) like Gather Town and Stardew Valley characters. Character: [young adult], [medium] build, [warm tan] skin, [short dark-brown] hair. Outfit: [teal short-sleeve shirt], [navy trousers], [white sneakers]. Accessory: [none / round glasses]. Pixel art, crisp clean pixels, single 1px dark outline, 2-3 shades per color, warm palette, soft light from the top-left, no anti-aliasing, transparent background.
